title: Retry changes the failed folder destination
observed: The requested _path was assigned only after listFiles succeeded; Retry used the previous _path.
impact: A failed src request could recover by showing root while the user expected src.
proposal: Record destination before loading, clear old entries on directory change, and assert retry/back request sequence.
verification: Final unchanged candidate: 75 focused tests/captures passed serially; flutter analyze clean. Synthetic dark/light 1x/2x populated, empty and folder captures inspected. No updated APK or device FPS/TalkBack claim.

title: Three enclosed header blocks compete with the file list
observed: Full-width pill selector, outlined search and filled change card precede content. The change card repeats a review instruction beside a chevron.
impact: The first file arrives after three strong shapes; the structure feels like stacked widgets rather than a browser.
proposal: Use flat selected tabs, retain one searchable field and a 48dp review row with unboxed counts.
verification: Final unchanged candidate: 75 focused tests/captures passed serially; flutter analyze clean. Synthetic dark/light 1x/2x populated, empty and folder captures inspected. No updated APK or device FPS/TalkBack claim.

title: Change state is repeated on two rails
observed: Added · +count is repeated with A badges. src repeats 3 changed files and trailing 3.
impact: Duplicate marks steal filename width and create a noisy secondary alignment rail. Single letters also require interpretation.
proposal: Keep full state words and counts once beneath each filename; remove redundant right-hand badges.
verification: Final unchanged candidate: 75 focused tests/captures passed serially; flutter analyze clean. Synthetic dark/light 1x/2x populated, empty and folder captures inspected. No updated APK or device FPS/TalkBack claim.

title: Accent folders overstate dependency and system content
observed: Every folder is filled mint, so .git, dist and node_modules are as prominent as src before the reader reaches source.
impact: Accent communicates folder type rather than a useful state and draws attention away from changed files.
proposal: Use neutral folder/file type icons; retain mint for selected tab and review entry. Keep all entries and server order.
verification: Final unchanged candidate: 75 focused tests/captures passed serially; flutter analyze clean. Synthetic dark/light 1x/2x populated, empty and folder captures inspected. No updated APK or device FPS/TalkBack claim.

title: Filename rail needs reliable geometry and room to wrap
observed: Dense ListTiles use a leading icon gutter and single-line filename; two separate state rails reduce available width.
impact: Long names truncate despite spare space elsewhere; optical alignment depends on ListTile defaults.
proposal: Set explicit 16dp outer rail, 24dp leading slot, 12dp title gap, 56dp minimum row and two filename lines.
verification: Final unchanged candidate: 75 focused tests/captures passed serially; flutter analyze clean. Synthetic dark/light 1x/2x populated, empty and folder captures inspected. No updated APK or device FPS/TalkBack claim.

title: Empty folder recovery is gesture-only
observed: The empty state says Pull down to refresh; shared empty-state widget is an always-scrollable SingleChildScrollView.
impact: Gesture is discoverable in copy but not an explicit button; no refresh bug demonstrated.
proposal: Verify pull-to-refresh. Keep truthful blank state; consider an explicit refresh control if device testing finds gesture friction.
verification: Final unchanged candidate: 75 focused tests/captures passed serially; flutter analyze clean. Synthetic dark/light 1x/2x populated, empty and folder captures inspected. No updated APK or device FPS/TalkBack claim.

title: Deleted file does not explain its tap behavior
observed: Deleted rows have onTap null and only Copy path in their context menu, though the changed-files sheet opens them in Review.
impact: Review remains available but the same file has different entry behavior depending on route.
proposal: Deleted rows now tap into the existing working-tree Review flow. All changed-file context menus include Open in Review.
verification: Final unchanged candidate: 75 focused tests/captures passed serially; flutter analyze clean. Synthetic dark/light 1x/2x populated, empty and folder captures inspected. No updated APK or device FPS/TalkBack claim.

title: Technical folder ordering needs a user-visible policy
observed: The observed server order begins .git, dist, node_modules, src. No hidden-files control exists.
impact: Daily source browsing requires scanning infrastructure folders first.
proposal: Do not silently hide or reorder returned files. A separately scoped remembered Show all / Source-first control needs supported semantics and persistence/deletion ownership.
verification: Source and accepted baseline images inspected; no new device proof.

title: Runtime motion and touch feedback remain unproven
observed: Source debounces search by 350ms and suppresses stale requests. A static frame cannot establish input latency, dropped frames or pressed feedback.
impact: No award-level fluidity claim is supported by page screenshots.
proposal: Device check search typing, keyboard back, folder transitions, overscroll, long press, TalkBack and frame timings on updated signed build.
verification: Source and accepted baseline images inspected; no new device proof.

title: Folder breadcrumbs have a fixed-height clipping risk
observed: The horizontal breadcrumb ListView was forced to 52dp despite scalable chip labels and shared chip padding.
impact: At large text the chip content can exceed its viewport height and lose visual bounds.
proposal: Use an intrinsically tall horizontal scroll view with the same accessible ActionChips; verify nested-folder renders at 1x and 2x.
